model_result.minimal_synthetic_mechanism: common pollinator-environment shift x heterogeneous initial lineage position in a functional matching trait space

empirical_mapping_principle.target_construct: signed initial plant position relative to the pollinator functional environment
empirical_mapping_principle.why_signed: A symmetric matching score can show how well a plant matches but cannot distinguish which side of a shifting functional optimum the plant occupies. v12 branch direction depends on position, not merely absolute mismatch magnitude.
empirical_mapping_principle.outcome_blind_requirement: mapping, source units, weighting and baseline regime must be fixed before any new downstream reproductive target is inspected
forbidden_substitutions: FDQ as if it were signed plant position
TM_sp_z as if it encoded the direction of trait mismatch
pollination syndrome as plant functional position
family or body-size proxy used as source-native proboscis length

evidence_routes.chronology: analysis existed in main before v12 residual mechanism test
evidence_routes.construct: mainland flower size as pre-island starting state; island/mainland flower-size response
evidence_routes.major_caveat: LR=log10(FI/FM) shares observed FM with the predictor; classical mainland measurement error can induce negative coupling

evidence_routes.baseline_regime_candidate: Oshima bridge-state or a separately frozen mainland baseline; choice must be source-justified before downstream test

plant_trait_available.measurement: species x site mean from five flowers

evidence_routes.pollinator_trait_target: 2017 Table S2 species x site mean proboscis_length_mm
evidence_routes.pair_weight_or_functional_center_state: 2024 public archive contains derived network metrics/species summaries but no source-native plant x pollinator quantitative pair table suitable for reconstructing a signed plant-specific partner center
evidence_routes.unsigned_alignment_limitation: TM_sp_z can support retrospective alignment-magnitude checks but cannot identify the sign of plant position around a functional optimum
reopen_conditions: recover source-native numeric proboscis values with exact site identity
recover or identify a source-native quantitative plant x pollinator weighting sufficient to define the functional center, or predeclare a valid community-level center for the intended estimand
freeze baseline regime and signed-position formula before downstream reproductive outcomes are used for a new test

evidence_routes.baseline_metric: Oshima plant-specific TM_sp_z / source-native corrected trait matching
evidence_routes.use: check qualitative compatibility only; do not call held-out validation or causal confirmation

evidence_routes.limitation_for_v12: a single Campanula lineage cannot by itself identify cross-lineage initial-position branching
evidence_routes.value: can establish direct service/dependency layers and provide source-native prospective trait measurements for the focal anchor

supported: response heterogeneity is empirical across island systems
v12 identifies initial trait-position heterogeneity as the minimal source of within-run lineage sign branching in the declared ABM
an external pre-v12 Southwest Pacific analysis independently shows starting-state dependence of island floral response shape, subject to measurement-error sensitivity
not_yet_supported: real island reproductive branch sign is caused by signed plant position relative to pollinator functional optimum
the v12 standardized trait is numerically equivalent to corolla tube length
a universal functional optimum applies across island systems

next_decisive_task: Find or recover an independent system with source-native plant matching trait, pollinator functional trait/environment, and downstream reproductive response measured on compatible units; freeze the signed-position mapping before inspecting its downstream outcome. Izu can reopen for a direct signed test only when the missing source-native proboscis/weight information is available.
claim_boundary: This gate distinguishes model sufficiency, pre-existing empirical consistency and direct empirical identification. It intentionally leaves the focal signed-position mechanism unconfirmed rather than filling missing pollinator traits or pair weights with proxies.
